title: Open Nett's Safe
author: MapleStory M
summary: Open Nett’s Safe is an account-wide three-digit code minigame running July 16-29, 2026, with two free entries available each day and rewards for solving the safe.

sections.title: Rules
items: The event is account-wide and has no level requirement.
Two free entries are available each day.
Each play asks the player to solve a three-digit code.

notes: Structured summary verified against the official Nexon Forum event notice on 2026-07-27.
requirements: Use an available entry and solve Nett's three-digit code.
rewards: Safe-opening rewards listed in the official event notice
participation_steps: Use one of the daily entries.
Enter guesses until the three-digit safe code is solved.
